mapper.insert: insert into t_payment_record (payment_no, order_no, user_id, request_id, business_key, channel, amount_cents, paid_amount_cents, refunded_amount_cents, status, version, create_time, update_time) values (#{paymentNo}, #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{requestId}, #{businessKey}, #{channel}, #{amountCents}, #{paidAmountCents}, #{refundedAmountCents}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}) on duplicate key update payment_id = last_insert_id(payment_id)
